what: The appraisal result for a thing the person owns (spec/pages.md §6.11, spec/features/appraise.md): what it is, what similar ones sold for, what they would keep on each site, and the next step.

frame.who: Testing the water and clearing out, once per thing, often before they decide to sell at all; the flipper checks many in a row; a new person may arrive here before linking any site.
frame.came_to: Know what it is worth in a number they can trust, and whether it is worth selling.
frame.mistake_costs_most: A number with no source: the range is only ever from sold comparables, each site's row says when there are too few sales, and the sales are one tap away.
frame.ways_out: Keep it (just value it) saves the value and never asks to list it; a typed model number when the photo was not enough (ways-out §6.11); a site with too few sales shows no number instead of a guess.
frame.in_the_loop: Keep it only saves a value, so it acts and shows Kept with Undo; Sell this only starts the listing, and the price is set later on Plan where it waits for the person.
